models.unconditional_class_rate: Training-segment class frequencies applied unchanged to validation and test.
models.unconditional_mean_r: Training-segment mean Strong R applied unchanged to validation and test.
models.always_trade_one_open: Enter at every eligible M15 decision while flat, evaluated separately per direction.
models.multinomial_logistic: StandardScaler plus multinomial LogisticRegression; C selected only by validation multiclass log loss.
models.ridge_strong_r: StandardScaler plus Ridge regression on Strong R; alpha selected only by validation mean squared error.

probability_to_score: For multinomial logistic, score equals the dot product of raw class probabilities and training-only class-conditional mean Strong R.
calibration: Not performed in ML-04. Calibration belongs to ML-06.
refit_reason: The validation score distribution is used to freeze policy thresholds; keeping the train-fitted model unchanged makes the validation threshold directly transferable to test.
policy_threshold_rule: For each fold, direction and model, use the validation score quantile at 1 minus coverage with method=higher. Test requires score greater than or equal to the frozen threshold and score greater than zero. No test retuning.

position_rule.skip: skip when decision_time is earlier than the accepted prior trade exit_time
position_rule.equality: decision_time equal to prior exit_time is allowed
position_rule.reason: ML-04 evaluates LONG and SHORT estimators independently; combined portfolio netting is deferred.

selection_metrics.multinomial_logistic: minimum validation multiclass log loss; ties choose smaller C
selection_metrics.ridge_strong_r: minimum validation mean squared error; ties choose smaller alpha

test_metrics: Strong and Extreme trade count, mean R, total R, profit factor, drawdown and losing streak
